task.summary: Default task
feat: add ArrayUtilsTrait for recursive array merging functionality

feat(security): refactor security config updates in SecurityTrait
- Simplified the updateSecurityConfig method by removing unnecessary code and directly merging security configurations. - Updated the method to use arrayMergeRecursive for merging data. - Integrated ArrayUtilsTrait for better array handling. - Renamed tplConfigDoctrineYaml to configDoctrineYaml for clarity. - Adjusted the logic for writing configuration files to use self::$generator for consistency.

fix: update Writerside configuration for version 2.0.6
- Updated instance version in writerside.cfg from 2.0.5 to 2.0.6 - Added changelog entry for version 2.0.6 detailing fixes to User Make Command

feat(ArrayUtilsTrait): add arrayMergeRecursive method with updated behavior
- Implemented a new method `arrayMergeRecursive` that behaves similarly to PHP's `array_merge_recursive`, but does not convert non-array values to arrays, updating their values instead.
This enhancement improves the utility of the trait for merging arrays.

fix(entity): update table and index names in User Log entity template
- Changed table name from 'idm_user_log' to 'idm_user_user_log'. - Updated index names accordingly to reflect the new table name.

fix(UserLog): rename Log to UserLog in sources.php
- Updated the 'Log' entry to 'UserLog' in the sources.php file. - Adjusted the use statements and variable references accordingly.
refactor(entity): rename Log class to UserLog for clarity

fix(MakerCommonContact): update template path for contact files
Updated the path in the getTpl method to point to the correct directory for contact templates. This change ensures that the template files are correctly located when generating contact related components.
fix(entity): change user property visibility to public in ResetPasswordRequest template

chore: update Changelog for version 2.0.7
- Changed User Templates: - Updated table name for User Log entity - Renamed file Log.tpl.php to UserLog.tpl.php and updated entity name
- Fixed issues in User Templates: - Made $user attribute public in ResetPasswordRequest.tpl.php - Corrected template search directory in MakerCommonContact.php

fix: update instance version in writerside configuration
Updated the instance version from 2.0.6 to 2.0.7 in the Writerside configuration file. This change ensures compatibility with the latest features and improvements.

fix(compose): update PHP service image to idmarinas/php:8.2-xdebug
- Changed the PHP service configuration to use the new image instead of the previous build context.

feat(user): add soft delete and unique constraints to User entity
- Added SoftDeleteableEntity trait for soft deletion functionality. - Implemented UniqueEntity constraints for email and username fields to ensure uniqueness.

fix(ProfileController): remove unused IsGranted attribute from profile route
- Removed the IsGranted attribute from the ProfileController to clean up the code and improve maintainability. This change does not affect the functionality of the route, as access control is handled elsewhere.
refactor(contact): rename Log class to ContactLog for clarity

feat(Contact): add constructor to initialize createdAt and updatedAt
- Added a constructor to the Contact class to set createdAt and updatedAt properties using the DateTime class.

feat(User): initialize createdAt and updatedAt in User entity
- Added DateTime initialization for createdAt and updatedAt properties in the User entity constructor. This ensures that these fields are set to the current date and time upon instantiation.

ci: add release trigger for documentation build workflow

chore: update Writerside configuration and changelog for version 2.0.8
- Updated instance version in writerside.cfg from 2.0.7 to 2.0.8. - Added changelog entries for version 2.0.8, detailing changes and fixes: - Renamed `Log.tpl.php` to `ContactLog.tpl.php`. - Modified `ProfileController.tpl.php` to remove `IsGranted`. - Added `UniqueEntity` validators and `SoftDeleteable` in `User.tpl.php`. - Fixed initialization errors in `Contact.tpl.php` and `User.tpl.php`.
